description: Multiplayer Discord Activity party game where players compete to create AI-generated images matching secret themes

userStories.title: Server Foundation
acceptanceCriteria: Express server with TypeScript strict mode
Environment variables loaded (PORT, GEMINI_API_KEY, DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET, CORS_ORIGIN)
npm run build and npm run dev scripts work

userStories.title: Client Foundation
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build produces dist folder

userStories.title: Multiplayer Room System
acceptanceCriteria: Real-time player list updates via Socket.io

userStories.title: Lobby Phase
acceptanceCriteria: Show connected players list with names
Host can see 'Start Game' button when 2+ players

userStories.title: Theme System
acceptanceCriteria: Categories: Pop Culture, Absurd Scenarios, Mashups, Vibes, Challenges, Art Style Twists, Relatable Moments
No theme repeats within a game session
Random theme selection from chosen category
Theme data structure supports category filtering

userStories.title: Host Category Selection
acceptanceCriteria: Host sees category selector before starting game
Options: All Categories (default), plus each individual category
Selected category stored in game state
userStories.notes: Lets groups pick their humor style

userStories.title: Prompting Phase
acceptanceCriteria: Display secret theme to all players
Text input for prompt with character limit
Submit button sends prompt to server

userStories.title: Flux Schnell Image Generation
acceptanceCriteria: Accept prompt string, return base64 image
Handle API errors gracefully with fallback message
Response parsed correctly for image data
userStories.notes: Primary image generation for game images (~$0.003/image)

userStories.title: Generating Phase UI
acceptanceCriteria: Show fake humorous progress messages that rotate
Handle generation completion for all players
Transition to voting when all images ready
userStories.notes: Loading state between prompting and voting

userStories.title: Round Results Phase
acceptanceCriteria: Show original prompt that created it
Transition to next round or final results

userStories.title: Game Flow Controller
acceptanceCriteria: State machine: lobby → prompting → generating → voting → results → final
Game mode: Classic (same theme for all)

userStories.title: Style & Personality - UI Text
acceptanceCriteria: Room code styled as classified document
All loading/error messages use humorous copy

userStories.title: Style & Personality - Visual Design
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette: electric purple, hot pink, neon green, deep black
Bold arcade-style display font for headers

userStories.title: Loading States & Humor
acceptanceCriteria: Examples: 'Teaching AI what fingers look like...', 'Adding extra fingers (will fix later)...'
Connection lost: 'THE AI HAS ABANDONED US'
Generation failed: 'THE MACHINE SPIRIT IS DISPLEASED'
userStories.notes: Humor during wait states - already implemented in US-009 and US-015

userStories.title: Desktop Responsive Layout
acceptanceCriteria: Content fills horizontal space on desktop
Results display as grid, not vertical list
No narrow mobile-style column on desktop

userStories.title: Nano Banana Avatar Generation API
acceptanceCriteria: Calls Gemini 2.5 Flash Image API with photo + style prompt
5 styles: cartoon, anime, pixel, fantasy, sketch

userStories.title: Avatar Options UI
acceptanceCriteria: Three options: Keep Discord Avatar, Upload Custom Photo, AI Stylized Avatar
Upload accepts image files, crops to square
Photo preview stays visible after selecting AI style
Photo preview stays visible during generation
Generated avatar replaces preview on completion

userStories.title: Avatar Display Throughout Game
acceptanceCriteria: Fallback to Discord avatar if no custom avatar

userStories.title: Audio Engine Core
acceptanceCriteria: Web Audio API initialization on first user interaction
AudioEngine class with play() and startLoop()/stopLoop() methods
Proper node cleanup to prevent memory leaks
Graceful fallback if Web Audio unavailable

userStories.title: Audio - Game Phase Sounds
acceptanceCriteria: Countdown tick with pitch drop, tension in last 5 seconds
Phase transition: bass drop with glitch stutter
Image reveal: heavy impact bass thump

userStories.title: Audio - Results & Ambience
acceptanceCriteria: Score tick up: rapid ascending blips
AI processing ambience: low drone with glitch pops

userStories.title: Model Provider Selection
acceptanceCriteria: Host sees model selector in lobby
Options: Nano Banana (full features), Flux Schnell (fast & cheap)
When Flux selected: AI avatars disabled, @mentions disabled
Selected provider shown to all players

userStories.title: Chaos Mode - Cosmic Modifiers
acceptanceCriteria: 100+ modifiers across categories: Style, Context, Chaos, Vibe
Random modifier applied to each prompt
Reveal shows modifier that was applied
Host toggle for chaos on/off in lobby

userStories.title: Glitch Token Economy
acceptanceCriteria: Token count displayed next to player

userStories.title: Sabotage - Word Injection
acceptanceCriteria: Sabotage UI panel during prompt phase

userStories.title: Sabotage - Additional Types
acceptanceCriteria: Style Override (3 tokens): replace style with 'Minions style', 'bad tattoo', etc.
Photobomb (2 tokens): your avatar injected into their image
Prompt Swap (4 tokens): exchange prompts with target
Mystery Box (1 token): random effect weighted toward cheaper ones
Max 2 sabotages per player per game

userStories.title: Sabotage UI & Animations
acceptanceCriteria: Incoming warning with screen edge flash

userStories.title: Chaos End-Game Stats
acceptanceCriteria: Agent of Chaos: most sabotages used
Karma: sabotaged someone who beat them

userStories.title: @Mention Autocomplete
acceptanceCriteria: Shows all players with avatar thumbnails
Display as styled tag/chip after selection
Warning if more than 3 avatars mentioned

userStories.title: @Mention Image Generation
acceptanceCriteria: Include mentioned player avatars as reference images
Track mentioned players in image metadata

userStories.title: Marketing Landing Page
acceptanceCriteria: Same visual style as game (purple, pink, neon green)
Same audio engine integrated with mute
Hero with logo, tagline, CTA to play
What Is This section explaining game

userStories.title: Deploy Server to Render
acceptanceCriteria: Build: cd server && npm ci && npm run build
Environment variables set (GEMINI_API_KEY, FAL_API_KEY, DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET)
Server logs show no startup errors

userStories.title: Deploy Client to Render Static
acceptanceCriteria: Build: cd client && npm ci && npm run build
CORS_ORIGIN on server updated with client URL

userStories.title: Discord Activity Configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Activities enabled in Discord Developer Portal
Root URL set to client URL
URL mappings for /api prefix to server
Activity appears in Discord Activities menu

userStories.title: End-to-End Playability Verification
acceptanceCriteria: Can create room and get room code
Second player can join with code
Players see each other in real-time
Full game playable in browser AND Discord Activity
